sinPagina.detalle: Teams are managed per page. Enable one in Integrations or ask to be invited to one.

explicacion: Access is per page: each one has its own team. To add someone to another page, switch pages in the switcher on the left.
soloMirar: You can see the team, but only the page owner invites people and changes access.
invitadoHace: invited {cuando} · gets in by signing in with that email

vacio.detalle: Invite by email whoever needs to work on this page.

invitar.detalle: They'll get an email with a temporary password. Their access to this page is ready as soon as they sign in.
invitar.detalleSinCorreo: No email is sent: we show you a temporary password to send by WhatsApp or however you like. They change it when they sign in.

leyenda.nota: Publishing doesn't need a Facebook account: it goes out with the token saved when the page was connected. Reconnecting it in Meta does require being an admin of the fan page on Facebook's side, and that isn't up to this app.

editarNombre.ayuda: The name belongs to the person: it changes in every brand they're in.

temporal.botonAyuda: Create a temporary password to send yourself. Any previous one stops working.
temporal.aviso: We don't store it: copy it now. If you lose it, create another (the previous one stops working). They'll choose a new one when signing in.
temporal.yaTieneCuenta: {email} already had a Clipfine account: they have access now and sign in with their usual password.
